sample_tickets.subject: Password reset link not working
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I've been trying to reset my password for the past hour, but the reset link I received doesn't work. When I click it, I get an error saying the link has expired. I've tried requesting a new link three times now, but the same thing keeps happening.

This is really frustrating because I need to access my account urgently to check on a project deadline.

Can you please help?

Thanks,
John Doe

sample_tickets.subject: How to export project data?
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

I need to export all data from one of my projects including tasks, time entries, and comments. I looked through the documentation but couldn't find clear instructions on how to do this.

Could you please guide me through the process?

Best regards,
Sarah Chen

sample_tickets.subject: Billing question - charged twice
sample_tickets.body:
Hi Support Team,

I just noticed that I was charged twice for my Professional plan subscription this month. I see two charges of $240 on my credit card statement, both dated February 1st.

This appears to be an error. Can you please investigate and refund the duplicate charge?

Account email: mike.johnson@techstartup.com

Thank you,
Mike Johnson

sample_tickets.subject: Slack integration not sending notifications
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I set up the Slack integration yesterday following the instructions in your help center, but I'm not receiving any notifications in our Slack channel. I've double-checked the settings and everything looks correct.

Can you help me troubleshoot this?

Thanks,
Lisa Martinez

sample_tickets.subject: Enterprise plan pricing inquiry
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

We're currently on the Professional plan with 50 users, but we're growing rapidly and expect to have 200+ users by the end of the quarter.

Could you please provide information about Enterprise plan pricing and features? We're particularly interested in:
- SSO integration
- Dedicated support
- Custom SLA
- Advanced security features

Would it be possible to schedule a call to discuss our needs?

Best regards,
David Kim
CTO, Enterprise Solutions Inc.

sample_tickets.subject: Mobile app keeps crashing on iOS
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

The TaskFlow Pro iOS app has been crashing constantly on my iPhone 14 Pro. It happens whenever I try to open a task with attachments. I've tried:
- Restarting my phone
- Reinstalling the app
- Clearing the cache

Nothing works. I'm running iOS 17.3. This is making it impossible to work on the go.

Please help!

Emma Wilson

sample_tickets.subject: How to set up recurring tasks?
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

I need to create tasks that repeat every week (weekly team meetings, status reports, etc.). I see there's a recurring task feature, but I'm not sure how to set it up.

Could you provide step-by-step instructions?

Thank you,
Robert Brown

sample_tickets.subject: Cannot invite team members
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I'm trying to invite new team members to our workspace, but when I enter their email addresses and click 'Send Invite', nothing happens. No error message, no confirmation - just nothing.

I'm using Chrome on Windows 11. Is this a known issue?

Jennifer Lee

sample_tickets.subject: Feature request: Dark mode
sample_tickets.body:
Hey TaskFlow team,

I love your product, but I really wish there was a dark mode option. I work late hours and the bright white interface is hard on my eyes.

Are there any plans to add dark mode in the near future?

Thanks,
Alex Thompson

sample_tickets.subject: Downgrade to Free plan
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

Due to budget constraints, we need to downgrade from our Starter plan to the Free plan. How do I do this? Will we lose any data?

Also, when will the downgrade take effect?

Thank you,
Maria Garcia

sample_tickets.subject: Time tracking not syncing
sample_tickets.body:
Hi Support,

I've been tracking time on tasks using the mobile app, but when I check on the web version, the time entries aren't showing up. This has been happening for the past 3 days.

I need accurate time tracking for client billing. Please help resolve this ASAP.

Chris Anderson

sample_tickets.subject: How to use Gantt chart view?
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

I just upgraded to the Professional plan to get access to the Gantt chart feature. However, I'm not sure how to use it effectively. Could you provide some guidance or point me to a tutorial?

Thanks,
Nicole White

sample_tickets.subject: API rate limit exceeded
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

We're getting 'rate limit exceeded' errors when calling your API. We're on the Professional plan which should allow 10,000 requests/hour, but we're only making about 5,000 requests/hour.

Can you check if there's an issue with our account?

Kevin Davis
Lead Developer

sample_tickets.subject: Cannot upload files larger than 50MB
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

I'm trying to upload design files to a task, but I keep getting an error saying the file is too large. The file is 75MB, and according to your documentation, the limit should be 100MB.

What's going on?

Amanda Rodriguez

sample_tickets.subject: Request for refund
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I signed up for the Professional plan 3 days ago, but after trying it out, I've decided it's not the right fit for our team. Can I get a refund?

I understand you have a 14-day trial, but I was charged immediately upon signup.

Brian Taylor

sample_tickets.subject: GitHub integration setup help
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I'm trying to set up the GitHub integration, but I'm stuck at the authorization step. When I click 'Authorize', I get redirected to GitHub, but then nothing happens.

Can you help me troubleshoot?

Stephanie Moore

sample_tickets.subject: How to archive completed projects?
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

We have several completed projects that are cluttering our workspace. How can we archive them so they don't show up in the main project list but are still accessible if needed?

Thanks,
Daniel Jackson

sample_tickets.subject: Email notifications too frequent
sample_tickets.body:
Hi,

I'm getting way too many email notifications from TaskFlow Pro - every comment, every task update, every mention. It's overwhelming my inbox.

How can I reduce the frequency or customize which notifications I receive?

Rachel Green

sample_tickets.subject: SSO integration for Enterprise plan
sample_tickets.body:
Hello,

We're interested in upgrading to the Enterprise plan primarily for SSO integration. We use Okta for identity management.

Can you provide details on:
1. SSO setup process
2. Supported identity providers
3. Implementation timeline
4. Any additional costs

Thomas Harris
IT Director
